records.title: Schemes for Handloom Weavers in Nagaland
details: (d): To support the handloom sector across the country including Nagaland, these schemes are under implementation till 2025-26. Further, impact assessment studies are underway for EFC proposals of new schemes or enhancing existing ones beyond 2025-26.

records.title: EMRS IN NAGALAND
details:
(a) & (b): Under the Central Sector Scheme of Eklavya Model Residential School (EMRS) 
440 EMRSs have been approved (in 2018-19), with one EMRS in every block having more than 50% ST population and at least 20,000 tribal persons (as per census 2011). With 288 EMRS schools funded (before 2018) under Grants under Article 275(1) of the Constitution, total 728 schools have been approved, of which 715 schools have been sanctioned across country. 
22 EMRSs have been approved for Nagaland, of which 03 are functional. It is the responsibility of the State Government to provide land for construction of schools and make schools functional from alternate building till the construction of school building is complete. Presently 19 EMRSs (02 under Article 275 (1) and 17 under New Scheme) are non
functional, as they are under construction by the State Government.
